reviewContext.scope: earn/gig slot — round-3 (final) re-review of round-2 FAIL fixes
reviewContext.note: No Bash/shell tool was available in this review context, so `node --test` and `bash run.sh` were NOT executed — all verdicts are from static disk-only analysis (the adversary's disk-only mandate). Each round-2 claimed fix was checked against the actual code, not the commit message.

evidence.description: auditNoHuman scans comment-stripped executables for stdin/readline/read -p/ask-human/wait-for-human patterns; real regex set, not a no-op.
Loop spawns the slot with stdio ['ignore','pipe','pipe'] — stdin physically ignored, slot cannot block on a human.
settle resolves 'did I earn?' via record-earn's on-chain scan, never a human prompt; detect/bid/deliver use stored creds only.
record-earn dependency contains no stdin/prompt read.

do_settle sets earn ONLY by parsing record-earn's 'VERIFIED +X USDC' line; the nonzero EARN_LEDGER line (with external:true) is written ONLY inside the `[ "$earn" != "0" ]` branch, so it cannot be produced without record-earn's chain-verified output. CANNOT fabricate an earn.

VERIFIED prints only when earned>0 from EXTERNAL inflows (from ∉ MY_WALLETS), block-cursor based on the FINALIZED head, logs re-verified (topic0==Transfer, address==USDC, padded to==founder), fail-closed. Self-transfers sum to 0.
Gates are observation-only; V1..V4 passing yields $0; earnFromSettle returns only externalEarnUsdc.
wallet_address emits only an address-shaped field (startswith 0x, len<=44); the planted 66-char leak key (contract.test:13) would be rejected by the length filter even if present in wallet.json.
available_rails reads only env KEY NAMES (grep '^...=' then strip '='), never secret values.
bid-run output JSON is task/jobId/title/bid_ok/http only; DEALWORK_API_KEY passed via env, never printed.

Loop scrubs *_WALLET_KEY into child env and redacts private-key patterns from observation + ledger line; contract.test:64-67,91 asserts the planted keys never appear in stdout/stderr incl. the settle path.

Mode is driven by $ANICCA_ARGS (the real loop channel, buildSkillEnv index.mjs:445), GIG_MODE only a manual fallback; always exits 0; unknown mode falls back to detect; each mode bounded by inner timeouts under SKILL_TIMEOUT_S.
FIND-004 genuinely fixed: shouldRecordBid(r)=== r.ok===true; bid-run.mjs:33 records only on success so a failed POST stays retryable; bid.test:44-49 asserts the rule.

FIND-006 partially improved: settle assertions earn_usdc===0 + !external are now non-tautological for the no-inflow path (a fabricated earn would fail). The 'oracle invoked' sub-assertion is weak — see FIND-002.
POSITIVE — FIND-002(r2) genuinely fixed: ONE shared AI_HINT in ai-hint.mjs, imported by BOTH detect.mjs:15 and bid.mjs:13; grep confirms no local AI_HINT redefinition remains in either.
POSITIVE — FIND-003(r2) genuinely fixed: laborxJobs() deleted; detect spreads only [...dw]; remaining 'laborx' references are accurate not-yet-coded comments; can-run.mjs:21-23 offers only dealwork.
POSITIVE — FIND-005(r2) genuinely fixed: record-earn path uses ${ANICCA_HOME:-$HOME/anicca} (portable), no hardcoded $HOME/anicca.

FAIL — the settle line written by run.sh:139 lacks `tx` and `status:"0x1"`, so isProfitable() returns false on every gig wake even for a real external inflow. The loop FINDS the line by wake but never classifies it profitable. FIND-001 (the core round-2 defect) persists. No test covers the profitable-settle path (FIND-002).

round2FixesConfirmedReal: FIND-002 (single shared lib/ai-hint.mjs imported by detect+bid; no local copy)
FIND-003 (laborxJobs deleted; detect spreads only dw; docstring accurate)
FIND-004 (shouldRecordBid records only on r.ok; bid.test asserts it)
FIND-001 PARTIAL (--wake passed + line written to the loop's EARN_LEDGER with wake=$WAKE; path+key correlation now correct)
round2FixesNotReal: FIND-001 INCOMPLETE — settle line omits tx+status:0x1, so isProfitable rejects it; real earns are found but never classified profitable (the exact defect FIND-001 named still stands)
FIND-006 PARTIAL — settle test's 'oracle invoked' assertion /record-earn|settle:/ is tautological (settle: always printed)
